subject: chemistry
context: The inherited data/extracted/chemistry_pass1.json (if any) could not be trusted as citable per-question evidence; Pass 2 requires real question records, so Pass 1 was rebuilt from the organized source PDFs.
alternatives: run Pass 2 on a hollow batch and report zero families
rebuild Pass 1 from the source PDFs, then run Pass 2
selected: rebuild Pass 1 from the source PDFs, then run Pass 2
rationale: The PDFs in data/organized/chemistry are tracked in git and have a clean text layer (verified with pypdf), so every Pass 2 claim rests on a real question record with a verified source SHA-256.

subject: chemistry
context: data/organized/sample_manifest.json must not be trusted for chemistry paper/memo pairing.
evidence: printed DATE / MARKS / EXAMINER header blocks
alternatives: verify each pairing from the printed headers and use only matching pairs
selected: verify each pairing from the printed headers and use only matching pairs
rationale: Using a cross-paired memorandum would attribute one sitting's marking guidance to another paper, corrupting every marking_requirements field downstream.

subject: chemistry
context: Pass 2 says confidence is 'high' with 4+ member questions across different papers, 'medium' with 2-3, and never 'high' if all support comes from one paper.
alternatives: author confidence by hand per family
selected: compute it from member evidence, requiring 4+ members across 3+ papers for 'high'
rationale: An asserted confidence cannot be audited; a computed one can, and it changes automatically as the batch grows.

subject: chemistry
context: Each extracted question record is assigned to at most one family.
selected: enforce a partition - each record belongs to at most one family
rationale: Overlap would let one question inflate several families and make frequency counts meaningless. Records fitting no family are reported unassigned (UNRES-CHEM-021) rather than force-fitted.

subject: chemistry
context: Pass 2 names family fields that database/schema/question_family.schema.json does not have (additionalProperties: false).
alternatives: relax the repo schema to accept the prompt's field names
map the prompt's fields onto the repo schema
selected: map onto the repo schema: member_source_ids -> source_evidence, distinguishing_features -> definition + assessment_operations + topics, typical_marks_range -> _PASS2_SUMMARY.json
rationale: The persisted object must validate against the repository schema, which IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC Phase 8 makes authoritative.

subject: chemistry
context: Some recurring patterns meet the member minimum but rest on too few papers to generalise.
alternatives: defer them to unresolved_items and say so
selected: defer them to unresolved_items, flagged UNRES-CHEM-024
rationale: Their marking_requirements could not be generalised from the evidence. Nothing is hidden - it is in unresolved_items.json with its evidence, so promotion is a one-line change.

subject: chemistry
context: Chemistry Phase 2 (ORC) never ran and no data/raw/chemistry/SOURCE_INVENTORY.yaml exists, so no SOURCE-* id can anchor the Pass 1 records.
evidence: SUBJECT_PROMPTS.md: do not invent ORC ids or a fake inventory
alternatives: invent a SOURCE-CHEM-* inventory to satisfy the schema
carry the sentinel SOURCE-ORC-CHEM-NOT-INDEXED and record the gap
selected: carry the sentinel SOURCE-ORC-CHEM-NOT-INDEXED and record the gap (UNRES-CHEM-ACQ-001)
rationale: AGENTS.md and SUBJECT_PROMPTS.md forbid fabricating provenance. The referential chain chemistry_{year}_{board}_{ptype}_{period}_q{qn} -> SOURCE-ORC-CHEM-NOT-INDEXED terminates at the sentinel rather than at a real ORC id, and the gap is explicit.
